stem:
Gopal models $(+3)-(+7)$ with tokens. He may add zero pairs (one positive with one negative), then remove the requested tokens.

Which plan is correct?

options.text: Add four zero pairs to make seven positives, remove seven positives, and leave four negatives: $-4$.
Call the answer a zero pair and stop there.
First remove seven positives from the three he has, and only afterwards add zero pairs to make the removal possible.
Cancel as in token addition without removing the seven positives.

teacher.key_rationale: Start with 3 positives; add 4 zero pairs to have 7 positives and 4 negatives; remove 7 positives; leave −4. Naming only “zero pair” substitutes a label. Removing before adding zero pairs reverses the needed order. Cancelling as in addition conflates addition with subtraction.
